title: Historical public-baseline research replay evidence
goal: Bind exact Git and inert research inputs to claim-native proof before building the bounded research run.

observations.claim: The historical public baseline commit, tree, parents, tree listing, and AGENTS content are available as the recorded Git objects.
observations.pass_condition: Fresh Git object reads reproduce every stored commit/tree/config digest and tree-entry count.
observations.route_guidance: Run known inputs and assert the exact outputs.
observations.observed_evidence: Read-only Git commands reproduced commit 7147b97, tree af6dc132, 13,502 tree entries, and stored SHA-256 observations.
observations.counterevidence: A missing object, different tree or parents, entry-count change, or digest mismatch refutes the claim.

observations.claim: The seven supplied research artifacts match the byte lengths and SHA-256 identities in the inert input manifest.
observations.pass_condition: Fresh byte reads of all seven inputs reproduce every manifest length and digest without executing package code.
observations.route_guidance: Run known inputs and assert the exact outputs.
observations.observed_evidence: Read-only hashing reproduced all seven recorded lengths and SHA-256 values.
observations.counterevidence: Any absent input, length change, or digest mismatch refutes the claim.

observations.claim: The technical disposition preserves useful research signals while refusing redundant or authority-expanding proposals and keeping unknown human benefit visible.
observations.pass_condition: The disposition maps every retained signal to evidence/current capability, preserves rejected/deferred proposals, and grants no automatic action or truth authority.
observations.route_guidance: Inspect the artifact against declared acceptance criteria.
observations.observed_evidence: The current-reality audit records repaired/reused organs, open human evidence, rejected recursive/global authorities, and unchanged CANON.
observations.counterevidence: A silently dropped dissent, unsupported PASS, auto-action grant, or hidden UNKNOWN refutes the claim.

limitations: Git object availability is local evidence and does not prove the remote branch is currently unchanged.
Artifact-to-model mapping and cross-model independence remain user-reported or unknown.
Technical disposition does not substitute for Mike's merge/CANON decision or voluntary human-benefit evidence.
